name: calculator-multiply
about: Multiply two whole numbers in the macOS Calculator (Basic mode) and read the result. A harmless live demo of the screen engine: taps, typing, a read, a code check and one Jev check.
notes: Mapped on macOS 26 Calculator, Basic mode. OCR sees AC, × (as X or x) and = but not 0, 4, + or ÷, so digits are typed and the operators tapped. Clear is Escape twice (the first press clears the entry, the second clears all); mid-entry the clear button shows 'C', which OCR misses, so tapping it was fragile. The display reads a lone 0 as 'O'. Positive whole numbers only: a leading '-' would press minus.

judge.instructions: Is this a calculator showing a finished result?

criteria.true: The display shows a completed sum: an expression such as 7x6 with its answer below it
criteria.false: The display is blank, shows only one number being typed, or shows an error

context.screen_text_is: OCR of the display, top line first
